description: The chart in Figure 2 is a nested pie chart illustrating the taxonomy of medical ethics. The chart consists of two main layers, with the inner circle representing four categories and the outer circle representing 26 categories. The four inner categories are labeled as "Autonomy" (blue), "Justice" (purple), "Beneficence" (dark blue), and "Non-maleficence" (red), each occupying approximately 25% of the inner circle. The 26 outer categories are distributed across the four inner categories, with varying proportions and colors, including shades of pink, orange, and purple. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels for the inner categories are clearly visible. The outer categories are not labeled directly on the chart, but their distribution across the four inner categories is visually represented. The segments appear to be ordered by their association with the inner categories, rather than by size or any other apparent pattern.
